messages:
sam_csm: Heads-up — we're prepping a renewal QBR for Olio Health next week. Major asks: verify token econ health, spot any sudden embed-heavy spend, and recommend a runway action. I'll attach the latest spend snapshot.

maria_cs: Got it. Pulling last 90d token and embed trends now. I think the spike on 3/9 is traffic-related, not prod change. :mag_right:

devon_finops: If you want, I can run a 30/60/90 forecast and propose guardrail alerts. thinking thresholds: `monthly_cost >= $5k` and `week-over-week > 40%` to trigger ops. ok?

liz_onboarding: On enablement — we can run a targeted onboarding refresher (30m) for their ML infra team. Also want to capture product feedback about latency/timeout which often drives retries and costs.

billing-bot: Usage report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/finance/reports/olio-usage-1763009999 — 90d tokens=1.2B, embeddings=420M, 30d spend=$6,400.

sam_csm: thanks @billing-bot. @maria_cs can you paste the sample prompt set causing embeds spike? we need examples for the QBR slides.

maria_cs: here's a redacted prompt sample:
```
User: summarize all patient notes and return vectors for 12k records
System: batch-size=500, similarity=0.75
```
This is run nightly via a scheduled job — looks like batch-size growth in Feb.

devon_finops: two quick suggestions: 1) advise them to cap batch-size to 250 or use incremental indexing; 2) enable prefix caching for repeat queries. I'll prepare a cost delta table.

liz_onboarding: For feedback capture, I suggest a short NPS + three targeted questions about latency, API ergonomics, and SDK docs. I can make a one-click survey and run it after the refresher.

sam_csm: owners: maria -> compile sample prompts + slides, devon -> forecast + guardrail thresholds + delta table, liz -> enablement + survey. Can everyone ack? :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: ack

devon_finops: ack

liz_onboarding: ack — scheduling refresher Wed 3/27 10am PT, sending calendar invite.

sam_csm: I'll draft the QBR agenda and share by EOD Tuesday. If we tag this as renewal risk=medium because spend jumped, let's flag AM so AE can prep. tagging @ae-jordan

ae-jordan: noted — will prep outreach and pricing flexibility options. please include renewal runway in slides.

sam_csm: perfect. small follow-up — devon, can you add a quick `what-if` showing cost with quantized model (8-bit) vs current? that'll help the pricing convo.

devon_finops: yep — will include quantization delta and latency tradeoffs. expect a preliminary table by tomorrow noon.

sam_csm: thanks team. closing thread here — collecting final assets into the QBR folder: https://redwood.internal/qbrs/olio-1763009999
